blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements for Workflow Automation. To view all the older release notes of Workflow Automation, go to ZIA Release Upgrade Summary (2023).

blocks.heading: Auto-Populate Manager's Name in the Incident Details Page

blocks.text: In the Incident Details page, when you escalate an incident to the user's manager for approval, the manager's email assigned to the incident is auto-populated in the Escalate window. You cannot edit the manager's email.
See image.
To learn more, see Viewing & Managing Incident Details.

The incident count provided in your user or DLP admin digest notification message for Email, Slack, and Microsoft Teams is only accurate to the date and time when the notification is generated. The count changes as new incidents are created, reassigned, or resolved.
To learn more, see Responding to a User Digest Notification and Responding to a DLP Admin Digest Notification.
In the Incidents page, you can search for an incident using duplicate transaction IDs. The search displays the actual transaction ID of the incident created because of the policy violation.
See image.
To learn more, see About Incidents.
An incident can be deleted by selecting the Delete action for the incident on the Incident Details page.
See image.
To learn more, see Viewing & Managing Incident Details.

blocks.heading: Enhancements to Incident Group Mapping and Workflow Mapping

blocks.text: The incident group mapping and workflow mapping are enhanced. The EQUALS, NOT_EQUALS, CONTAINS_EXACT, and NOT_CONTAINS_EXACT operations make case-insensitive comparisons with the value entered for the property.
To learn more, see Managing Incident Group Mappings and Managing Workflow Mappings.
The Incidents page is enhanced.

blocks.item: The Priority filter enables you to filter incidents by all priorities or by only high and critical priorities.
The Open, Resolved, Waiting Feedback, and Escalated widgets display a blue bottom border after the widget is selected.

blocks.text: See image.

blocks.heading: Enhancements to Workflow Automation API: New Audit Logs Endpoint

blocks.text: A new POST /dlp/v1/customer/audit endpoint is added to the Workflow Automation API. You can use this endpoint to filter audit logs for every action made by the admins or APIs based on the specified time period and field values.
To learn more about the endpoint, see Understanding Workflow Automation API and API Rate Limit Summary.
The Postman collection is also updated to include the new resource. To learn more, see Configuring the Postman REST API Client.

blocks.heading: Export Incidents to a CSV File

blocks.text: The incidents that are displayed on the Incidents page can be exported to a CSV file by clicking the Export icon.
See image.
To learn more, see About Incidents.

blocks.heading: Notify User and Close Incident Workflow Template

blocks.text: The Notify Owner and Close Incident workflow template notifies the user that generated the incident and closes the incident if a response is not received from the user after a configurable time period in seconds.
See image.
To learn more, see Managing Workflow Templates and Managing Workflows.

A new Roles page is added to the Setup > Roles and Permissions menu in the Workflow Automation Admin Portal. This page enables you to create roles and assign permissions to control a DLP admin's access to the major features of Workflow Automation.
See image.
As part of this feature, a new Roles field is added to the Setup > Admins > Add Admins window. You can add multiple roles to an admin while configuring admin assignments.
See image.
Ensure that you configure roles and permissions before configuring admin assignments.
To learn more, see Managing Admins and Managing Roles and Permissions.
